# HomeCare — On-Demand Home Services Marketplace

A **Java Spring Boot backend** for an on-demand home services platform where customers can book services, helpers can accept and fulfill bookings, and administrators can manage users, bookings, and payments.

The project focuses on backend engineering concepts including **JWT authentication, role-based access control, JPA/Hibernate persistence, booking state management, geo-based helper assignment, wallet management, and payment processing**.

## 🚀 Key Features

### 🔐 Authentication & Authorization

* JWT-based authentication with access and refresh tokens.
* Role-based access control for **Customer, Helper, and Admin** users.
* Secure API access using Spring Security.
* Password reset and token revocation support.

### 📅 Booking & Helper Assignment

* Implemented a **state-driven booking lifecycle**:

```text
PENDING → ASSIGNED → HELPER_EN_ROUTE → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED
```

* Automatically assigns the **nearest available helper** based on:

  * Geo-distance
  * Service type
  * Helper availability
  * Working hours
  * Scheduled booking time
* Supports customer-requested/preferred helpers.
* Prevents invalid booking state transitions using business-level validation.
* Provides APIs for helper acceptance, rejection, travel initiation, job start, and completion.

### 💳 Wallet & Payment System

* Implemented a customer wallet for managing booking payments.
* Integrated **Razorpay** for online payment processing.
* Implemented payment **hold/release workflows** around booking completion.
* Added cancellation policies with **full and partial refund** support.
* Maintains wallet transaction history and booking payment records.
* Supports recurring subscription payments through wallet-based debits.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Layer       | Technology                 |
| ----------- | -------------------------- |
| Language    | Java 17                    |
| Framework   | Spring Boot                |
| Security    | Spring Security, JWT       |
| Persistence | Spring Data JPA, Hibernate |
| Database    | PostgreSQL                 |
| Payments    | Razorpay                   |
| Real-time   | Spring WebSocket / STOMP   |
| Scheduling  | Quartz Scheduler           |
| Build Tool  | Maven                      |
| Testing     | JUnit 5, Mockito           |

## 🏗️ Backend Architecture

```text
                    Client / Frontend
                           │
                           ▼
                  Spring Boot REST API
                           │
          ┌────────────────┼────────────────┐
          │                │                │
          ▼                ▼                ▼
      Security          Booking          Payment
     JWT + RBAC         Module            Module
          │                │                │
          │                ▼                ▼
          │        Helper Assignment      Wallet
          │        Booking State          Razorpay
          │        Management             Refunds
          │
          └────────────────┬────────────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                    JPA / Hibernate
                           │
                           ▼
                       PostgreSQL
```

## 📌 Core Backend Modules

* **User Module** — registration, authentication, JWT, roles and profiles
* **Booking Module** — booking lifecycle, state validation and helper assignment
* **Payment Module** — wallet, Razorpay payments, holds, releases and refunds
* **Subscription Module** — recurring service plans and renewals
* **Tracking Module** — helper location and ETA tracking
* **Notification Module** — in-app, email and SMS notifications
* **Admin Module** — user, booking, payment and platform management
* **Review Module** — helper ratings and reviews
* **Dispute Module** — booking disputes and financial resolution

## 🔄 Booking Flow

```text
Customer
   │
   ▼
Create Booking
   │
   ▼
Find Available Helpers
   │
   ▼
Geo-distance Filtering
   │
   ▼
Nearest Suitable Helper
   │
   ▼
Assign Helper
   │
   ▼
Helper Accepts
   │
   ▼
Service In Progress
   │
   ▼
Service Completed
   │
   ▼
Payment Released
```

## 💡 Backend Engineering Highlights

* Designed business logic around **explicit booking states** instead of allowing unrestricted status updates.
* Used **JPA/Hibernate** for entity relationships and persistence.
* Implemented geo-distance based helper discovery for automated assignment.
* Separated authentication, booking, payment, notification and administration responsibilities into dedicated modules.
* Implemented transactional wallet and payment operations to maintain consistency between booking and financial records.
* Added scheduled background processing using Quartz for tasks such as booking expiry and subscription renewal.
* Used WebSocket/STOMP for real-time booking, tracking and communication features.

## ▶️ Getting Started

### Prerequisites

* Java 17+
* Maven 3.8+
* PostgreSQL

### Clone

```bash
git clone <your-repository-url>
cd homecare
```

### Configure Environment Variables

```text
JWT_SECRET=<your-secret>
RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=<your-key>
RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET=<your-secret>
```

### Run

```bash
mvn spring-boot:run
```

The application starts on:

```text
http://localhost:8080
```

## 🎯 Project Objective

The objective of HomeCare is to build a production-style backend that demonstrates how a real-world service marketplace can handle **authentication, booking workflows, automated resource assignment, payment processing, persistence, and asynchronous backend operations using Java and Spring Boot**.
